name: Gathering
for: a conference, festival, meetup, workshop series or any event with a programme and tickets
description: Poster type at full width: the name, the dates and the city before anything else, then the programme day by day as real tables, the speakers with what each will say, tickets with what they include and how many are left, and the venue. Paper and black with one loud yellow-green.

type.display: "Avenir Next Condensed", "Arial Narrow", "Roboto Condensed", system-ui, sans-serif
